entries.why_wrong: Swapping the whole structure isn't necessary — the dict itself is fine, it's just that this particular key type can't be hashed. Converting `arg_list` to a `tuple` before using it as a key keeps the dict and fixes the crash.

Changing `results` to a list wouldn't relate to the crash at all — the error happens because `arg_list` is used as a dict key, not because of what `results` is. A list also can't reproduce the lookup-by-key behavior this function is going for.

The function does return `results` at the end, so a missing return isn't what raises the exception. The crash happens earlier, on the line assigning into `results[arg_list]`, before the return is ever reached.
